description: Execute a two-voter election, commit and apply leader 1 demotion to learner, isolate the peers, elect sole voter 2 and apply a new write. Invoke fresh reads separately on learner 1 and voter 2 and drain all bounded Ready work. Measure shortcut eligibility on actual ReadStates, preserving missing results and diagnostics. The current voter is the permitted control; write/read indexes and application values are consequence diagnostics, not a global linearizability oracle.

harness.description: Public RawNode driver with MemoryStorage modeling completed persistence and no crashes. A common index-1 snapshot supplies only initial membership/history. All subsequent election messages, demotion proposal/commit/application, successor election and write commitment execute through target APIs. Deterministic network delivers messages until quiescence before partition, then drops inter-node messages. No protocol implementation is substituted.
semantic_changes: No target edits. Host state machine stores the last nonempty normal entry as a diagnostic value.
Network isolation is modeled by dropping inter-node messages; no messages or votes are fabricated.
RawNode.Status and Ready.ReadStates are observational APIs; CA_EVENT records host scheduling and output.

legality.derivation: NewRawNode recommends initial Storage snapshot membership. Ready entries/HardState are stored before queued messages are delivered; committed entries are applied consecutively with ApplyConfChange before Advance. Demotion uses public ProposeConfChange and Changer.Simple changes one voter. StepDownOnRemoval=false is supported; learner remains a participant. Only actual generated messages reach Step; isolation occurs after both nodes install demotion.
legality.applicability: No crashes or disk-failure model. Two initial voters are allowed though README recommends larger deployments for availability. Common bootstrap snapshot is declared, not represented as an executed prehistory.

grounding.derivation: Observe actual returned ReadStates for fresh requests in ReadOnlySafe with no incoming message during each read. Under the accepted singleton shortcut duty, the local node must be the sole installed voter; compute that predicate from Status.Config membership, not role or the shortcut result.
grounding.applicability: Actual two-node demotion history; all configuration entries applied before Advance. Read completion is optional: a missing result remains unknown rather than requiring success.
alternatives: No ReadState is a permitted pending outcome; the current sole voter supplies a positive completion control.

observable_properties.description: For an observed ReadState produced with no incoming quorum message after this fresh read admission, the responding node must itself be the sole installed voter. The control may return; the learner may remain pending. No completion is forced.

uncertainties: The checked proposition is local read-support eligibility, not a measured client linearizability endpoint.
No crash persistence or asynchronous-storage ordering is exercised.
An initial common snapshot substitutes bootstrap prehistory; all histories material to demotion and reads execute.
